blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: BST — Binary search tree ordered by key.
inorder — Left subtree, root, right subtree.

blocks.title: Discover
blocks.text: A binary search tree (BST) keeps smaller keys in the left subtree and larger keys in the right subtree under a consistent duplicate-key policy.

blocks.title: Trace
blocks.text: Each node stores a key and optional Left/Right child references. Inserting begins at the root and follows comparisons until an empty child link is found.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: Inorder traversal (left, root, right) prints sorted keys for a valid BST without duplicates.
